title: Kakutani Fixed Point Theorem (Infinite-Dimensional)
description: Formalizes Kakutani's fixed point theorem for set-valued maps and its infinite-dimensional generalization (Fan-Glicksberg). Includes application to Nash equilibrium existence and the hierarchy of fixed point theorems.

meta.author: Kakutani (1941), Fan (1952), Glicksberg (1952)
meta.assumptions: 2 axioms (kakutani_finite_dim, fan_glicksberg) and 0 sorries. NOTE: IsNashEquilibrium is defined as True (placeholder); nash_equilibrium_existence is trivially proved and does not constitute a real Nash equilibrium result. The genuine content is the Kakutani/Fan-Glicksberg axiomatizations and the brouwer_from_kakutani_finite derivation.
